title: Affine opens of an affine-transition limit descend to a stage
statement: Let $I$ be a small cofiltered category, $D:I\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ a diagram whose transition morphisms are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and let $c$ be a limit cone with quasi-separated stages [def-pc-scheme]. For every affine open subset $U\subseteq c.\mathrm{pt}$, there exist an index $i\in I$ and an affine open subset $V\subseteq D(i)$ such that $c.\pi_i^{-1}(V)=U$ as open subschemes of the limit.
